sections.content_text: Section 77 - Exclusion from Total Income (1) The income earned by any person specified in Part 1 of the Sixth Schedule shall not be included in computing the total income of that person in the said income year, provided that it shall be included in the computation of the source of funds for the said income year, subject to the following conditions, namely: (a) Deductions from the total income in the return shall be properly shown for in the relevant column; and (b) The source and amount of income shall be furnished in detail in the return. (2) Grants made by any person under Part 2 of the Sixth Schedule shall be excluded from the total income of such person in computing the tax subject to the following conditions, namely:- (a) the grant is reflected in the return or particulars or documents annexed to the return; (b) the total amount of the grant made under Part Il of the Sixth Schedule does not exceed 10% (ten percent) of the total income shown before; (c) Source and amount of income filed in detail in the return.
